why: A now contains, beside the 14 theorems of the row, the new theorem_19_8_6_five_hyp, metrizableSpace_natTopPull and isOpen_natTopPull_iff (Chapter19/CoveringContent). theorem_19_8_6_five_hyp is clause (5) for a transition construction of Definition 19.8.4 under IsCompatible: |A|, |B|, |E_B| and |P*E_B| are metrizable for the topologies generated by NatOpenA, T_{|B|}, NatOpenEB and NatOpenPull (the collection of Definition 19.8.20 for the Γ̂ : τ*W → P*E_B). For |P*E_B| it is Lemma 19.8.21 for the bundle covering square of (P, μ_B): toSq makes F̃ a square uniformizer construction with toSq.toPullback = F̃ whose NatOpenEA is NatOpenPull. The blind NatOpenPull is the project's (natOpenPull_iff, proved). B ⇒ main (B_to_main): B's clause (5) does not use IsCompatible. Under IsCompatible all of B follows from the conjuncts theorem_19_8_6_one_four and theorem_19_8_6_five_hyp (A_to_B_of_compatible), with Kb = bundleG and Kh = bundleHat. A_to_B is not obtained: B has no IsCompatible, which does not follow from Definitions 19.8.4/19.8.5 (definition_19_8_4_without_compatible), and A states |A| and |P*E_B| metrizable only under it (|B| and |E_B| need no compatibility). B_to_A is not obtained: A is about the project's bundleG, bundleHat, mulBundleG, contains the structure maps of M(Γ, Γ') and the identification of the opens of the topology of |P*E_B| with NatOpenPull, which B does not state.
overlap: HARNESS (as in V19_97): the vocabulary definition Umap mentioned by B has value ⟨(m̂ h, p̄ h), mGmap_pbarMap h⟩, so every term about B reaches the item theorem mGmap_pbarMap; plain rt_check of B_to_main and A_to_B_of_compatible therefore does not pass on that single name (recorded with #guard_msgs), and rt_check with mGmap_pbarMap removed is OK for both. rt_overlap B_to_main: 1126 shared project theorems, the proof fields of altH, pbarMap, Umap (hence mGmap_pbarMap) and M-polyfold / strong bundle infrastructure reached by unfolding B's statement; no other item theorem.

main.note: main is clause (5) of B with IsCompatible added (B_to_main proved). With theorem_19_8_6_one_four it gives all of B under IsCompatible (A_to_B_of_compatible). Witness: absFt_theorem_19_8_6_five (absFt is coherent and compatible).
